title: Kimmswick Express
author: Gene Hubert
problems: Row 4 "pass through to face Sides" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 5 "neighbors do si do 1¼ to a wave of 4 (2 robins in the middle by the left, neighbor right) · do-si-do" can't start from where the dancers are: There is no room for the two to meet.
Row 5 "neighbors do si do 1¼ to a wave of 4 (2 robins in the middle by the left, neighbor right) · ocean-wave" can't start from where the dancers are: An ocean wave needs four dancers.
Row 9 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: There is no room for the two to meet.
Row 10 "partners promenade along the set on the right to home" can't start from where the dancers are: Every couple must be the same number of places from home.
The progression after row 10 "partners promenade along the set on the right to home" doesn't work out: Lark 2 has no robin on the right.
Row 1 "Heads forward & back" can't start from where the dancers are: There is no room to walk forward.
Row 2 "right left through Heads" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle must come as two couples.
Row 3 "circle left 3 places Heads" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle must come as two couples.
Row 6 "balance right & left" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 8 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
